modifications: none; the official executable is unchanged. Local launch scripts only configure and initialize the instance.
configuration: launch.py: private PostgreSQL 16 cluster in DATA_DIR (Unix socket only, with a private TMPDIR socket directory when the data path is too long); RUN_MIGRATIONS, BASE_URL http://127.0.0.1:PORT, POLLING_FREQUENCY 1440, fixed MEDIA_PROXY_PRIVATE_KEY, INTEGRATION_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORKS; outbound HTTP through the runtime's HTTP_PROXY; three baseline users (alice administrator, bob, carol) created on first start

notes.runtime_dependency: PostgreSQL 16 server from the task base image (Ubuntu 24.04 package postgresql-16)
